description: Updates the person (the account holder) or the company with what the person states: roles, organizations, places, links, key facts, category, best known for, competitors, people or companies with the same name, and an answer per result (mine, about_me or not_me; sent again to change it). Sent as confirmed facts on every scan. Use this when the person gives or corrects a fact. Do not use for facts the person did not state. Side effects: changes the account's own record.

create.description: Make a record when there is none: kind person or brand, with its name and domain. Example: {"kind": "brand", "name": "Northwind Studio", "domain": "northwind.example"}

facts.description: Facts the person states (roles, organizations, places, links, key facts, category, best known for, competitors). Example: {"roles": ["Founder"], "places": ["Lisbon"]}

name.description: The name, when it changes or for a new record. Example: "Northwind Studio"

namesakes.description: Other people or companies with the same name, as the person describes them. Example: ["A footballer in Brazil with the same name"]

profile_id.description: The person or the company to change (default: the person). Example: "5f0c2a9e-7b1d-4c3e-9a8f-2d6b4e1c7a90"

results.description: An answer per result: mine, about_me or not_me; send again to change it. Example: [{"url": "https://dailyledger.example/dana", "answer": "about_me"}]

name: update_reputation_profile
title: Update the reputation profile
